body:
## What this tour is

This is a multi-day bus tour of Okinawa's main island, sold by KKday. You choose between two and three days, and each day covers one part of the island: the north, the centre or the south. Everything starts and ends in Naha, so you stay in the city and the tour comes to you.

## The days

The northern day takes in Manzamo, Kouri Island, Churaumi Aquarium and American Village. The central day lists Southeast Botanical Gardens, Cape Zanpa, the Kadena Air Base observation deck and a shopping mall. The southern day goes to Chinen Misaki Park, Okinawa World with Gyokusendo Cave, Itoman Fish Market and Umikaji Terrace on Senaga Island. The two-day package we read combined the northern and southern routes; other pairings and a three-day package are offered.

## The guide's language

The listing states the guided language as Mandarin and describes a Chinese-speaking guide. It does not mention English, so if you need an English guide this listing is not the right one.

## What is included

The fare, tolls, parking, the guide and attraction tickets are included, plus lunch on the northern day and, on the southern day, lunch, the DMM Kariyushi Aquarium ticket and a glass-bottom boat. Personal expenses and accommodation are not included.

## Booking details

Pick-up is in Naha at 8:30 on day one in front of the BLUE SEAL store at RYUBO Department Store, and at 8:40 on day two at Naha Prefectural Office. Cancellation is free up to 6 days before the date. Children aged 0 to 5 are free; children aged 6 to 12 pay a lower fare.

## When it fits

It suits travellers who want to see the island's main sights without renting a car and are comfortable with a Mandarin-speaking guide. It is a bus tour with a group, so it is less flexible than a private car.
